lex:
ὑπογραμμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:28 * ;]
__1. a writing-copy, hence,
__2. an example: 1Pe.2:11 (Philo).†

strongs.def: an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively)
strongs.from: from a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and G1125 (γράφω)
